findings.title: Missing End-to-End Verification
findings.issue: The coder only verified that 'Frontend build completes successfully' but provided no evidence that account creation actually completes through the password step, password validation works, form submits correctly, or OTP flow continues after password entry.
findings.consequence: Unknown if the fix actually resolves the user's reported issue 'account creation stops in the password'
findings.correction: Provide manual testing evidence showing: (1) User can type password in registration form, (2) Password validation displays correctly, (3) Form submission succeeds with password value, (4) Account is created in backend, (5) OTP step is reached after password submission.

findings.title: Inconsistent Interface Pattern
findings.issue: Login.jsx uses the native Input component with standard event handlers onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}, but PasswordInput now uses a different interface passing values directly. This creates two different patterns in the codebase for password handling.
findings.consequence: Future developers may be confused about which pattern to use. If Login is refactored to use PasswordInput, it will break. Inconsistent API makes the component harder to maintain.
findings.correction: Either: (1) Update Login.jsx to use PasswordInput for consistency, OR (2) Document the interface difference clearly in PasswordInput component comments, OR (3) Make PasswordInput support both interfaces by detecting whether the callback expects value or event.

findings.title: No Password Validation Testing
findings.issue: The coder did not verify that password validation callbacks still work correctly after the interface change. onPasswordChange expects a value and updates both password and confirmPassword errors. PasswordStrength component displays based on password state. No evidence these still work with the new interface.
findings.consequence: Password validation may be broken, allowing weak passwords or missing error feedback to users during registration.
findings.correction: Provide test evidence showing: (1) Password strength indicator updates as user types, (2) Password validation errors display correctly, (3) 'Passwords do not match' error works for confirm field, (4) Form submission validates and enforces password requirements.
